headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 2, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBI. In other action, the Seattle Mariners edged the Minnesota Twins 4-3, with Randy Arozarena leading the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. PJ Poulin has been transferred to the 60-day injured list by the Washington Nationals due to a left flexor strain. Jake Fraley has been placed on the 60-day injured list by the Tampa Bay Rays with a hernia. Lenyn Sosa is out with a right wrist contusion, placed on the 60-day injured list by the Toronto Blue Jays.

The New York Mets traded RHP Freddy Peralta to the Tampa Bay Rays for RHP Gary Gill Hill, OF Aidan Smith, and SS Émilien Pitre. The Chicago Cubs traded RHP Jameson Taillon and cash to the Toronto Blue Jays for a player to be named later. The Los Angeles Dodgers traded CF Zyhir Hope, RHP River Ryan, and RHP Brady Smith to the Detroit Tigers for LHP Tarik Skubal.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Fall to Blue Jays 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays secured a 5-1 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Kevin Gausman earning the win after 5.2 innings of work. George Springer led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Mariners Edge Twins in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Seattle Mariners secured a 4-3 victory over the Minnesota Twins, with Randy Arozarena leading the Twins' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 1 RBI. Logan Gilbert pitched 7 strong innings for the Mariners, striking out 6 and allowing 3 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Rays Take Down White Sox 1-0**
top_news.summary: The Tampa Bay Rays secured a narrow 1-0 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Drew Rasmussen pitching 6.0 innings of shutout baseball, striking out 10 batters and allowing just 4 hits. Nick Fortes led the Rays' offense with a single that scored the game's only run.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Mets 6-2**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 6-2 victory over the New York Mets, with Javier Sanoja leading the charge at the plate. Sanoja hit 2 home runs and drove in 2 runs, while Tyler Phillips earned the win for the Marlins.

top_news.title: **Phillies Shut Out Orioles 8-0**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies dominated the Baltimore Orioles, securing an 8-0 victory. Impact hitters for the Phillies included Bryce Harper, Alec Bohm, Justin Crawford, and Bryan De La Cruz.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Atlanta**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 2-4 decision to the Atlanta Braves, marking their latest loss. Matt Olson and Mike Yastrzemski were among the impact hitters in the game.

top_news.title: **Nationals' PJ Poulin Shifted to 60-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: Washington Nationals left-handed pitcher PJ Poulin has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a left flexor strain. This move will impact Poulin's availability for the remainder of the season.

top_news.title: **Mets Make Key Trade Ahead of Deadline**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have traded RHP Freddy Peralta to the Tampa Bay Rays in exchange for RHP Gary Gill Hill, OF Aidan Smith, and SS Émilien Pitre. This move is one of several expected ahead of the MLB trade deadline on August 2.
